taylor.marketing: Quick heads-up  final SEO/redirect runbook for Wed launch + webinar recording post. Need: final KW list, JSON-LD (Event + VideoObject + FAQ + HowTo), internal link map, and redirect cleanup. Can @nik.seo take KW/schema and @marta_ops handle redirects? doc: https://tiny.redwood/launch-bench-runbook

nik.seo: On it. Suggest canonical = https://redwood.com/learn/launch-benchmarks-qa. Product page /product/benchmarks will point to canonical via contextual links. Seed hero KWs: "LLM inference benchmarks", "inference throughput vs latency", "inference cost per token". I'll add 6 longtails and intent tags.

marta_ops: Confirmed canonical URL above. For UTM: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=launch_bench_may. I'll schedule redirect window with eng-release.

samira_pm: Small note: landing must include H1 variant with primary keyword and a short explainer paragraph for readability and accessibility. Also need to ensure the webinar video page includes transcript for VideoObject.text.

nik.seo: Longtails draft: "inference throughput by GPU model", "LLM serving cost comparisons", "batch size latency tradeoffs", "quantized model inference latency", "optimizing inference cost for startups", "benchmarking dedicated inference clusters". Anchor map: link to /docs/batching ("batching and latency tradeoffs"), /pricing ("inference pricing examples"), /case-studies/startups ("startup benchmark cases"). Avoid generic CTAs.

release-bot: redirect-scan: /benchmarks-legacy -> 302 -> /blog/old-bench. Recommendation: create 301 /benchmarks-legacy -> /learn/launch-benchmarks-qa. Run: `redirect-plan --create 301 /benchmarks-legacy /learn/launch-benchmarks-qa --note "consolidate promo paths"`

marta_ops: I'll open the release ticket and schedule cutover Tue 10am PT. QA checklist: 1) Screaming Frog crawl post-cutover for redirect chains; 2) JSON-LD validate at validator.schema.org; 3) Confirm rel=canonical points to /learn/launch-benchmarks-qa; 4) mobile UA smoke; 5) check internal links use descriptive anchor text.

nik.seo: I'll paste JSON-LD snippets into the doc after finalizing. Plan to include HowTo for quick benchmark steps (3 steps), set mainEntityOfPage to canonical, and include VideoObject with transcript and uploadDate.

taylor.marketing: Great. Action items: nik finalize KW list + post JSON-LD, marta schedule redirect + QA, samira check accessibility + transcript. Ping when done. Promo copy will be locked after redirects are consolidated. :rocket:
